decision: 5 second time penalty. 1 penalty point (total of 5 for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video and in-car video evidence. Car 44 overtook Car 23 on the straight before Turn 14, then Car 23 attempted to regain the position and in doing so he misjudged his proximity to Car 44 and his front wing collided with the rear left wheel of Car 44. In mitigation of penalty, this was a relavitively minor collision and Car 44 was unaffected by the incident.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 23 Collision With Car 44 In Turn 14
